scientific_integrity.literature_comparison: Closest same-object single-edge results examined in open primary full text; other related papers distinguished by objective and domain.
scientific_integrity.not_claimed: No physical empirical validation, no uniqueness or exhaustive priority guarantee, no independent audit.
scientific_integrity.proof: Analytic inverse-derivative and semidefinite eigenvalue argument, supplemented by exact symbolic and rational checks.

scientific_limitations: Conventional symmetric undirected Friedkin–Johnsen equilibrium only; not directed or nonlinear opinion propagation.
Joint intervention follows a fixed ratio of edge-weight increments; the classification does not cover changing direction.
Infinite-parameter conclusion is proved analytically; symbolic algebra only checks identities and finite rational examples.
Relevant unindexed specialist results may remain undiscovered; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A sharp two-edge safety window for opinion depolarization
